reviews.rationale: Accepted as the exact low-confidence, bounded selected-edition whole row. Compared all 23 running words/clusters, four stars, raised apparatus 23–32 and Roman III/IV boundaries in actual full selected print and the Uoft camera crop. Corrected my provisional first tree ending to undotted Wawe I ዕፀወ, versus the exception’s dotted ዕፀው, and Harm IV ኃ in ኃዲስ. The printed labialized Qaf in አቊጽሊሆሙ has connected mid-height horizontal spur with an upward terminal stroke, favoring II over the V control after whole-photo and headed-table comparison. My preliminary V read was not conclusive; retained II is supportable only with the explicit fine-order uncertainty. Both direct numeral clusters and repeated እም, including unusual lack of a separator within numeral-plus-noun clusters, remain. The full English preserves the two opening imperatives, how and qualified appearance, fallen foliage and fourteen-tree exception, not-shedding, old/new without a supplied noun, and two-and-three timing without smoothing to “or” or an exact duration. Notes a/b/c are supported by directly inspected appearance/dry/leaves/year lexicon photos, Charles apparatus and Greek printed7 where III stops immediately after all the trees. Note c discloses the time phrase’s ambiguous attachment and alternative winter/rainy-season sense; no source ending is imported. V2 adds exactly two source uncertainty entries, no changes to running source, full English or any note. This is not a resolution of uncertainty, chapter approval, or publication authority.
